title: Volvo Trucks - Emergency braking at its best!
summary: A one-minute Volvo Trucks demo of the Collision Warning with Emergency Brake system on a fully loaded 40-ton tractor-trailer, avoiding a rear-end collision on a test track.
why: Cited as a real-world example of automatic emergency braking already working on heavy trucks.

quote.text: Here's a really impressive video of it in action on a semi-truck
